# proxmox_version (Data Source)

Fetches Proxmox VE cluster version details from `/version`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "proxmox_version" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `console` (String) Default console viewer configured in Proxmox VE.
- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `release` (String) Current Proxmox VE point release in `x.y` format.
- `repoid` (String) Short git revision used to build this Proxmox VE version.
- `version` (String) Full `pve-manager` package version.
